now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In season 1, Ward and Garrett raid the Fridge and steal it for HYDRA.

changes.evidence: In Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. season 1 (episode 18, 'Providence'), Garrett and Ward steal the weapon from the Fridge and HYDRA uses it straight away as a cutting tool to free prisoners and dig for the Gravitonium. After the theft it is HYDRA's working weapon, not secured, until Coulson takes it back in the finale and stores it at the Playground.

now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In season 2, Kurt offers his own life to the Celestial Eson so Rogue and Gambit can be together.

changes.evidence: X-Men '97 season 2 episode 9 ('Survival of the Fittest', the season finale) ends with Beast telling Rogue that Nightcrawler gave his own life to Eson so she could live and be with Gambit. Marvel Database lists his death in that episode (CauseOfDeath: gave his life so Eson would spare his sister), and nothing later brings him back. 'Missing' does not fit a sacrifice of his life that the show states outright.
